title: Generation of human knock-in organoids by CRISPR-HOT
protocol: Identify the gene to target and design sgRNAs preferably in the last exon but preceding the stop codon.
Clone the sgRNA into the empty pSPgRNA with the reagents and protocol described in (Ran et al., Nature Protocol 2013).
Determine which frame selector to use according to where the sgRNA cuts in the genome.
Mix together 5 ug of sgRNA plasmid, 5 ug of the appropriate frame selector plasmid, and 5 ug of the universal NHEJ targeting vector.
Determine optimal organoid transfection protocol according to the organ type.
When tagging with a fluorescent tag, signal can be readily seen within 3-4 days in the case of endogenously expressed genes.
Pick organoids/cell clumps containing positive cells with a P200 pipette under a fluorescent microscope.
Make single picked organoids into single cells and grow/expand them until a line is generated.
Genotype by sanger sequencing of PCR fragments to confirm correct integration.
